record.targetedIssue: Secret-design request timing and alleged 2021 Act / 2022 commencement delta.
record.finding: Art. 14(2) in both the 2020 and 2024 WIPO consolidations allows the request at application filing or simultaneously with payment of the first-year design registration fee; art. 14(3) allows a shortening request. The enacted 2021 Act No. 42 does not amend art. 14, so no 2022 art. 14 timing change is established. Art. 25 allows an advisory opinion on the scope of the registered design, without a secret-design exclusion shown in the text.
record.effectOnAnswer: No answer blocker from the suspected timing amendment. The stored answer イ rests on availability of an art. 25 advisory opinion even during secrecy. Choice ア is not supported because art. 14(3) permits shortening.

record.finding: The stored official-question excerpt supplies the operative fee table: filing 14,000 yen and examination request 138,000 yen plus 4,000 yen for each claim. Four independent and ten dependent claims total fourteen; 14,000 + 138,000 + 4,000 x 14 = 208,000 yen.
